raw_segments.text: His lips lipped and mouthed fleshless lips of air, mouth to her moom, oom, all-wooming
His mouth molded issuing breath, unspeached, oo-ya-ha, roar of cataractic planets, globed,
blazing, roaring way, way, way, way, way, way.
Paper, the bank notes, blast them, old Deasy's letter, here, thanking you for the hospitality
Turning his back to the sun, he bent over far to a table of rock and scribbled words.
That's twice I forgot to take slips from the library counter.
